2. **Gunga Din (1939)** - An action-adventure film set in colonial India, featuring Grant as Thomas Lawrence, a British soldier on a mission to capture a notorious bandit.

These movies offer a great mix of romance, comedy, and adventure, all starring the incomparable Cary Grant.
